Results.ReviewText:
Great grill for my balcony! Perfect size for a single, couple or small family. Heats up quickly and easy to clean. I love it! 

Keep in mind the fuel connection is meant for small disposable propane tanks (it is a portable BBQ after all.) You can use a generic 'adaptor hose' from any hardware store if you want to use this BBQ with a 20lb tank. Just make sure it's got the 'adaptor' to convert from portable to the large tank. I got mine for $26.99CDN at Home Hardware. It doesn't have to be Weber's hose, since their hose seems to be getting really bad reviews because of the white ring breaking. 

BTW, Weber it really doesn't matter that you have a 2 year warranty on a faulty product. Perhaps it time to consider replacing your overpriced adaptor hose with one that doesn't break.
Results.Title: Use a generic 'adaptor' hose for 20lb tank

Results.ReviewText: This is an outstanding grill and our second Weber Q. We have a q3200 we have used as our main grill at home since 2014 and with just a little annual maintenance it still cooks great! These are durable, even-cooking machines that will reliably cook for years. So when we were looking for a grill for our camping adventures, we looked no further than the q1200. I can confidently say after 5 trips that this grill is every bit as reliable and solidly built as our q3200 and home, only smaller. Sure, you will pay a bit more for these grills, but they last for years. Great product, Weber!

Results.ReviewText:
This was a birthday gift and was easy to assemble. It lights easily and cooks pretty well. However, for the price I think they could have done better. It has a couple of design flaws, mainly with the handle above the regulator. 1. I have to push the regulator down with my fingers to get the tank threads lined up because the handle obstructs it. 2. And you cannot get you fingers around that handle because the regulator assembly is built right up against it. I'm an average sized guy but my girlfriends tiny hands were unable to grasp it as well. I would think an item that is a little heavy and awkward to carry would provide a good grip. 3. Because of how awkward it feels to carry, they should have included a lid lock.
In summary, it cooks well (so far) the aesthetics are great, and it has some good features, but it lacks in ergonomics and does not feel like it will travel well. So it's a good stationary grill for the home.
